item.title: Zigbook Is Plagiarizing the Zigtools Playground
item.description:
📝 wasm (sha256sum: 3a63e5092e8f90172716977af5c88b4f49e546f730f25e9bafb47f4ac9a2ee1d)OriginalPlagiarizedzig. That JavaScript code is absolutely required to interact with the ZLS binary which they did plagiarize. Zigbook either avoided copying that JavaScript code because they knew it would be too glaringly obvious, because they fundamentally do not understand how the Zigtools Playground works, or because they plan to copy more of our code.
🔗 Read more: https://zigtools.org/blog/zigbook-plagiarizing-playground/
